## Purpose

Assign a Cellosaurus accession to every cell line, extract its sequence
variations (mutations, deletions, amplifications, fusions) as a long table,
and derive a tissue label.

## Inputs

- `01_lines.rds` from `01_import_shorthouse.Rmd`
- `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/cellosaurus.txt`: Cellosaurus flat file (release in `config.yml`)
- `config.yml`: manual accessions for names that EV1 does not annotate

## Methods

Cell lines were identified by their Cellosaurus accession, taken from the
RRID column of Dataset EV1 where available, otherwise from the Cellosaurus
name given in EV1 (human entries, exact name match); two names without either
were assigned manually. Sequence variations were read from the Cellosaurus flat
file (release 53.0) and classified as mutation, engineered mutation, reported
wild type ("None_reported"), deletion, amplification or fusion. Cellosaurus
lists selected, literature-reported variations only, so the absence of an
entry does not imply a wild-type gene. Tissue of origin was assigned from the
disease annotation, falling back to the anatomical site the line was derived
from, using the rules of the original pipeline.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/cellosaurus.R"))
config <- load_config()
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "02_cell_lines_mutations")

line_data <- readRDS(file.path(derived_dir, "01_lines.rds"))
lines <- line_data$lines
cellosaurus_file <- file.path(raw_dir, config$cellosaurus$file)
cellosaurus <- read_cellosaurus(cellosaurus_file)
```

## Accessions

```{r accessions}
human <- filter(cellosaurus$entries, human)
manual <- bind_rows(lapply(names(config$cellosaurus$manual_accessions), function(n) {
    m <- config$cellosaurus$manual_accessions[[n]]
    tibble(line = n, manual_accession = m$accession, manual_note = m$note, engineered = isTRUE(m$engineered))
}))

# EV1 may list several spellings of the Cellosaurus name (e.g. "HX147 || Hx147")
id_to_ac <- function(ids) {
    vapply(ids, function(x) {
        if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
        hits <- unique(human$ac[human$id %in% str_split(x, " \\|\\| ")[[1]]])
        if (length(hits) == 1) hits else NA_character_
    }, "")
}

cell_lines <- lines %>%
    select(line, member_names, n_injections, rrid, cellosaurus_id, disease_ev1) %>%
    mutate(ac_from_id = unname(id_to_ac(cellosaurus_id))) %>%
    left_join(manual, by = "line") %>%
    mutate(
        accession = coalesce(rrid, ac_from_id, manual_accession),
        accession_source = case_when(
            !is.na(rrid) ~ "EV1 RRID",
            !is.na(ac_from_id) ~ "EV1 Cellosaurus ID",
            !is.na(manual_accession) ~ "manual",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        engineered = coalesce(engineered, FALSE)
    )

# RRID and Cellosaurus name must agree where EV1 gives both
conflicts <- filter(cell_lines, !is.na(rrid), !is.na(ac_from_id), rrid != ac_from_id)
conflicts
stopifnot(!any(is.na(cell_lines$accession)), !grepl("\\|\\|", cell_lines$accession))
stopifnot(all(cell_lines$accession %in% cellosaurus$entries$ac))
count(cell_lines, accession_source)
```

Merged lines (several names) carry one accession only if all their names agree:

```{r merged-check}
cell_lines %>% filter(grepl(";", member_names)) %>% select(line, member_names, rrid, cellosaurus_id, accession)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(cell_lines$accession[!cell_lines$engineered]))
```

## Sequence variations

```{r variations}
variations <- cellosaurus$variations %>%
    filter(ac %in% cell_lines$accession) %>%
    parse_sequence_variations() %>%
    inner_join(select(cell_lines, line, accession, engineered), by = c("ac" = "accession"),
               relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    rename(accession = ac) %>%
    select(line, accession, gene, status, variation_type, kind, variant, zygosity, partner_gene, note, source, engineered)

# an engineered derivative inherits none of the parental line's variations
variations <- filter(variations, !engineered) %>% select(-engineered)

count(variations, status)
```

Per gene and line, one status is kept for quick use, with precedence
mutation > deletion > amplification > fusion > engineered > reported wild type.
A gene with no entry for a line is "not reported", not wild type.

```{r gene-status}
status_order <- c("mutation", "deletion", "amplification", "fusion", "repeat_expansion",
                  "mutation_engineered", "wild_type_reported", "other")
gene_status <- variations %>%
    mutate(status = factor(status, levels = status_order, ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(line, gene) %>%
    summarise(
        status = as.character(min(status)),
        variants = paste(unique(na.omit(variant)), collapse = "; "),
        .groups = "drop"
    )

gene_status %>%
    filter(gene %in% c("TP53", "KRAS", "EGFR", "STK11", "KEAP1", "CDKN2A", "PTEN", "BRAF", "PIK3CA")) %>%
    count(gene, status) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)
```

## Tissue

The rules are those of the original pipeline (disease text first, then the
derived-from site). Whether to use the tissue labels of Shorthouse et al.
instead is decided in the data inventory (Phase 1b).

```{r tissue}
site_rules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pattern,                                                     ~general_site,
  "^Not specified$",                                            NA_character_,
  "^Bone marrow$",                                              "Bone marrow",
  "^Peripheral blood$",                                         "Blood",
  "^Cerebrospinal fluid$",                                      "CSF",
  "Ascites|effusion",                                           "Body fluid",
  "lymph node|lymph duct",                                      "Lymphatic",
  "^Brain",                                                     "Brain",
  "^Bone(,|$)|innominate bone|acetabulum|femur|humerus|tibia|vertebra|jaw|maxilla", "Bone",
  "skin|dermis|hypodermis",                                     "Skin",
  "muscle|perineus|brachialis",                                 "Muscle",
  "^Lung|^Lung,",                                               "Lung/Pleura",
  "^Pleura$|pleura",                                            "Lung/Pleura",
  "^Liver$",                                                    "Liver",
  "intrahepatic bile duct|^Bile duct|^Gallbladder",             "Biliary tract",
  "^Kidney|renal pelvis",                                       "Kidney",
  "^Prostate$",                                                 "Prostate",
  "^Stomach$",                                                  "Stomach",
  "^Colon|^Cecum|ileocecal valve",                              "Colon",
  "^Rectum$",                                                   "Rectum",
  "^Pancreas|ampulla of Vater|islets of Langerhans",            "Pancreas",
  "^Breast",                                                    "Breast",
  "^Ovary",                                                     "Ovary",
  "^Uterus|cervix|^Endometrium$",                               "Uterus/Cervix/Endometrium",
  "^Thyroid gland$",                                            "Thyroid",
  "^Adrenal gland$",                                            "Adrenal gland",
  "^Salivary gland",                                            "Salivary gland",
  "^Esophagus$",                                                "Esophagus",
  "^Pharynx",                                                   "Pharynx",
  "^Larynx$",                                                   "Larynx",
  "^Oral cavity",                                               "Oral cavity",
  "^Urinary bladder$",                                          "Urinary bladder",
  "^Ureter$",                                                   "Ureter",
  "^Peritoneum$|^Omentum$|^Abdomen$|abdominal wall|pelvic wall|retroperitoneal", "Abdomen/Peritoneum",
  "^Spleen$",                                                   "Spleen",
  "^Neck$",                                                     "Neck",
  "^Orbital region$",                                           "Orbital region",
  "^Soft tissue$|^Connective tissue$",                          "Soft tissue"
)

disease_rules <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pattern,                                                     ~general_site,
  "lung|bronch|pleural|mesotheli",                              "Lung/Pleura",
  "bladder|urothel|urinary bladder",                            "Urinary bladder",
  "renal|kidney",                                               "Kidney",
  "pancrea|ampulla of vater",                                   "Pancreas",
  "breast|mammary",                                             "Breast",
  "ovar",                                                       "Ovary",
  "prostate",                                                   "Prostate",
  "colon|colorectal|cec",                                       "Colon",
  "rect",                                                       "Rectum",
  "glioblast|gliosarcoma|astrocyt|brain",                       "Brain",
  "leukemia|lymphoblastic|myeloid|myelogenous",                 "Blood",
  "myeloma",                                                    "Bone marrow",
  "melanoma",                                                   "Skin",
  "thyroid",                                                    "Thyroid",
  "adrenal",                                                    "Adrenal gland",
  "esoph",                                                      "Esophagus",
  "laryn",                                                      "Larynx",
  "pharyn",                                                     "Pharynx",
  "oral cavity",                                                "Oral cavity",
  "endomet|uter|cervi",                                         "Uterus/Cervix/Endometrium",
  "liver|hepat|bile duct|gallbladder|cholang",                  "Liver/Biliary",
  "soft tissue|connective tissue|sarcoma",                      "Soft tissue",
  "bone",                                                       "Bone"
)

# first matching rule wins
map_by_rules <- function(x, rules) {
    out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
        hit <- is.na(out) & str_detect(x, regex(rules$pattern[i], ignore_case = TRUE))
        out[which(hit)] <- rules$general_site[i]
    }
    out
}

clean_disease_text <- function(x) {
    x %>%
        str_replace_all("\\[|\\]|'", "") %>%
        str_replace_all("\\bNA\\b", "") %>%
        str_replace_all("\\s*\\|\\|\\s*", "; ") %>%
        str_squish() %>%
        na_if("")
}

entries <- select(cellosaurus$entries, ac, cellosaurus_name = id, derived_from_site, disease_cellosaurus = disease)
cell_lines <- cell_lines %>%
    left_join(entries, by = c("accession" = "ac")) %>%
    mutate(
        derived_site = derived_from_site %>% str_extract("(?<=;)[^;]+") %>% str_trim() %>% str_remove("\\.$"),
        disease_clean = clean_disease_text(disease_ev1),
        general_site_disease = map_by_rules(disease_clean, disease_rules),
        general_site_derived = map_by_rules(derived_site, site_rules),
        general_site = coalesce(general_site_disease, general_site_derived)
    )

count(cell_lines, general_site, sort = TRUE)
```

## Outputs

```{r save}
out <- c(
    cell_lines = file.path(derived_dir, "02_cell_lines.tsv"),
    variations = file.path(derived_dir, "02_sequence_variations.tsv"),
    gene_status = file.path(derived_dir, "02_gene_status.tsv")
)
readr::write_tsv(cell_lines, out[["cell_lines"]])
readr::write_tsv(variations, out[["variations"]])
readr::write_tsv(gene_status, out[["gene_status"]])
write_manifest(out, c(lines = file.path(derived_dir, "01_lines.rds"), cellosaurus = cellosaurus_file),
               file.path(derived_dir, "02_manifest.json"),
               extra = list(cellosaurus_release = config$cellosaurus$release))
```

## Interpretation

All lines have an accession; most come from the authors' own RRID annotation,
so manual mapping is limited to the two names EV1 does not annotate. The
engineered NCI-H460 derivative keeps the parental accession for identity but
receives no sequence variations. Reported wild-type entries are kept as such
and are not counted as mutations.
